Capability adapter — codex [partial]
  support levels: discoverable supported, selectable supported, invocable advisory, enforceable unsupported
  bootstrap: instruction-file
  acquisition: read shell:cat, search shell:ripgrep [partial]
  storage: consumer project <cwd>/tasks/active (cwd-keyed; not plugin-owned)
  gating events: none (no proven deny/block)
  ⚠ security/privacy enforcement gaps (3):
      pre_tool: pre_tool fires but cannot guarantee a block (codex PreToolUse deny documented but codex hooks are version-gated (CODEX_MIN_SUPPORTED_VERSION 0.142); deny needs a runtime version probe)
      prompt_submitted: prompt_submitted fires but cannot guarantee a block (codex UserPromptSubmit (capability table 0.142))
      stop: stop fires but cannot guarantee a block (codex Stop (capability table 0.142, observe))

  Invocation shapes
    invoke-skill     advisory     skill projected into the AGENTS instruction surface
    invoke-agent     advisory     codex subagent surface
    invoke-command   advisory     command projected into the instruction surface
    invoke-workflow  advisory     instruction-surface composition
    lifecycle-hook   advisory     codex hook (config.toml)
    none             unsupported  (not directly invocable)

  Workflow operations
    ask_user         local-fallback question asked inline in the assistant's prose
                     ↳ fallback: The agent asks in prose and waits. There is no structured option list and no host guarantee that the turn actually blocks.
    manage_plan      local-fallback plan files under tasks/plans/ (no typed task tool)
                     ↳ fallback: Plan state lives only in files. Nothing enforces that the agent updates them.
    run_shell        unknown      codex shell execution
    delegate_agent   unsupported  codex subagent surface

  Lifecycle events
    session_start      supported — codex SessionStart (capability table 0.142)
    pre_tool           advisory — codex PreToolUse deny documented but codex hooks are version-gated (CODEX_MIN_SUPPORTED_VERSION 0.142); deny needs a runtime version probe
    post_tool          supported — codex PostToolUse (capability table 0.142, observe)
    tool_failure       unsupported — codex exposes no tool-failure event
    prompt_submitted   supported — codex UserPromptSubmit (capability table 0.142)
    stop               supported — codex Stop (capability table 0.142, observe)
    pre_compaction     supported — codex PreCompact (capability table 0.142)
    subagent_start     supported — codex SubagentStart (capability table 0.142)
    subagent_stop      supported — codex SubagentStop (capability table 0.142)
